plain: Aldo Rebelo, a former defence minister of Brazil, tells Jesse Michels about a belief concerning Roraima, a state in the far north of Brazil. He says it is believed that American satellites scanning the planet for minerals shake violently, almost to the point of falling, when they pass over Roraima, because the signal from its rare earths, valuable metals used in electronics, is so strong.
